title: Role Access Management
description: Review the proposed permission model for every role and access audience. This is a read-only policy preview — access is enforced by the server.

readOnly.title: Read-only preview
readOnly.description: This page shows the proposed permission matrix. Editing and server-side enforcement arrive in a later step, so nothing here changes live access yet.

stateDescriptions.limited: Allowed only within the scope and conditions described.
stateDescriptions.denied: Not permitted. Requests are rejected by the server.

roleNotes.agent: Agent is not a system role. An approved agent keeps the Customer (USER) role and is granted the reseller feature set on top of it.

usersRead.label: View users
usersRead.description: Search and view user accounts and their permitted profile details.

usersUpdate.label: Update users
usersUpdate.restriction: Limited to roles the actor is allowed to manage.

usersBlock.label: Block or unblock users
usersBlock.description: Restrict or restore a user's ability to sign in.
usersBlock.restriction: Requires permission to manage the target role.

usersDelete.label: Delete users
usersDelete.description: Soft-delete an account and revoke its sessions.
usersDelete.restriction: Cannot delete accounts outside the actor's management scope; Super Admin accounts are protected.

rolesManage.label: Manage user roles
rolesManage.description: Assign a different role to a user account.
rolesManage.restriction: Cannot grant or revoke privileges beyond the actor's own scope; the Super Admin role is protected.

rolePermissionsManage.label: Manage role permissions
rolePermissionsManage.description: Configure the global role-permission matrix shown on this page.

offersManage.label: Manage offers
offersManage.description: Create, update and delete telecom offers and catalogue content.

ordersManage.label: Manage orders
ordersManage.description: Review and progress customer orders through their lifecycle.

walletRead.label: View wallet details
walletRead.description: View wallet balances and transaction history.

walletAdjust.label: Adjust wallets
walletAdjust.description: Credit or debit a user's wallet balance.

withdrawalsReview.label: Review withdrawals
withdrawalsReview.description: Approve, reject or mark withdrawal requests as paid.
withdrawalsReview.restriction: Final approval and payout steps are restricted to finance roles.

commissionsManage.label: Manage commissions
commissionsManage.description: Configure commission rates and review agent commission earnings.
commissionsManage.restriction: Affects only the actor's own commission or rates on content they manage.

auditLogsRead.label: Read audit logs
auditLogsRead.description: Review the recorded history of sensitive administrative changes.

notAuthorized.title: Super Admin only
notAuthorized.description: Role Access Management is restricted to Super Admins. Your account does not have permission to view this page.

empty.title: No permissions match your search
empty.description: Try a different search term or clear the filters.

footerNote: The permissions shown here are the proposed target policy. The server remains the source of truth and enforces every check with default-deny.
